# console-1.2 run timing0: Pacing and pipeline items off together: queue depth, vblank priority, core 0, pace by vblank, bounded slip
# np-player.txt written by 1.3.0 build console-kit (the kit's files are not old settings files: the stale-settings guard leaves them as they are)
# tier 1, group timing, route tour, version payload 1.3, role ab
# Screening run for the five pacing items at once (all on in the default). The Galaxy port found that its own pipeline switches, all on by default, cost it frames: the Observatory went from 38.1 to 40.6 fps with them off. Whether the same holds here is open and only a console can say: compare the frame time p50/p95 and the late-frame count with d1/d2. Only if it differs from the noise do the single runs pay off (core0off is in the session as the first of them; the others are tier 2).
# ---- route and logging: the same in every run ----

MSC_FRAME_TIMING=300

MSC_WATCH=1
MSC_WATCH_EVERY=600
MSC_VITA_CLOCK_POLICY=max
# ---- under test: nothing here means the default ----

MSC_VITA_PRIO_VBLANK=0
MSC_VITA_CORE0_ALONE=0
